# Mini PDF Policy

Document ID: mini-pdf · Owner: People Operations · Effective 2026-01-01 · Version 2026.1
Topics: conduct

## Purpose and Scope

This miniature document exercises the PDF parsing path. Its text is extracted with pypdf from the
committed PDF, while its heading set is recoverable only because this source sits beside it.

## Our Standards

### Respect

Everyone in this fixture is imaginary and is treated well anyway.

### Candour

An imaginary concern raised early is easier to resolve than the same concern raised a year later.

## Contacts

Write to the fixture. It does not reply.
